title: get api workshops list available workshops
description: Test the GET /api/workshops endpoint to ensure it returns a 200 status with a list of available workshops without requiring authentication.

title: get api workshops id get workshop details

title: post api bookings create new booking
description: Test the POST /api/bookings endpoint to create a new booking with valid authorization and body, expecting a 200 response with booking details, and 400 for validation errors.

title: get api auth me get current authenticated user

title: get api profile get user profile details

title: put api profile update user profile

title: get api admin workshops list workshops for admin
